sentences.text: 6. Learned counsel for the applicant, at the very outset, submits that this is the third bail application.
The first bail application was rejected by this Court vide order dated 5.1.2021 on merits.
The second bail application was also rejected by this Court vide order dated 22.10.2021 in which the trial was directed to be expedited and specific direction was issued to the trial court.

Learned counsel for the applicant makes statement at Bar that as per his instructions on the basis of records provided to him there is nothing on record to show that the order dated 21.10.2021 of this Court expediting the trial, has been filed before the trial court.
He submits that even there is no pleading to the said effect in the affidavit filed in support of this bail application as to whether the said order has been filed before the trial court or not.
He thus submits that he is not in a position to state on the basis of records available with him as to whether the order dated 22.10.2021 has been filed before the trial court or not.

He submits that as such the applicant shall be filing the said order before the trial court within a period of three weeks from today and the present bail application be dismissed as withdrawn at this stage.
7. The prayer as prayed by learned counsel for the applicant is allowed.
8. The present third bail application is dismissed as withdrawn.

(Samit Gopal,J.) Order Date :- 20.7.2023 Naresh  Manzoor Ahmad vs State Of U.P. on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51078028/
